caption:
I haven't picked my own workout in two months and I'm stronger for it

#fitnessapp #workout #soma

slides.text:
I don't choose
my workouts anymore

It tells me why

"HRV below your baseline —
a moderate day fits best"

The session is already there

Blocks, reps, and how hard
each one should feel

Forty minutes

I just do what it says

And it closes the loop

"A solid night tonight pushes
tomorrow into a harder day"

slides.heading: The decision is the hard part
slides.body: SOMA reads your recovery, picks the session, and tells you what it based it on
